summary_1line: Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana settle peacefully in the hermitage until the demoness Shurpanakha arrives, becomes infatuated with Rama, and questions his presence in the forest.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shurpanakha, a grotesque demoness, gazes lustfully at the radiant Rama standing beside Sita in the forest hermitage.
Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana perform ablutions in the Godavari River at sunrise before returning to their leaf-thatched hermitage.
Rama with matted locks and bow in hand stands calmly in the forest while the enamored Shurpanakha approaches him.
